messages:
maria_csm: Arkwell just sent a vendor security pack — 45-page questionnaire + a DPA addendum asking for SOC2 controls mapping and evidence. They want a response by EOD Thursday. Can we triage? :eyes:
sam_solutions: OK. Can you drop the link? I'll skim the Qs and flag any technical asks that need engineering input.
maria_csm: https://redwood.internal/s3/arkwell/q2-requests.pdf (shared)
joel_sec: I'll own the security control answers (encryption, key mgmt, vuln scanning). Quick heads-up: they want key rotation cadence and HSM details. We can reference our KMS integrations and include the internal key rotation policy doc.
tim_legal: I'll look at the DPA addendum redlines. If they try to add broad subcontractor obligations we should push back and provide our standard subprocessor list instead.
sam_solutions: Scanned the questionnaire: Section 3 is deep on data flows (ingress/egress), they want sample network diagram and data retention timelines. Do we have a canonical diagram?
joel_sec: Yes. Use infra-diagrams/rlw-infra-dataflow-v3.png (internal). Also attach our retention table: retention_policy_v1.2.pdf. For encryption at rest: AES-256 with envelope encryption via AWS KMS (cmk rotation 365 days). For in-transit: TLS1.2+ and mutual TLS for Dedicated customers.
maria_csm: Perfect — can someone paste a short reply we can send to Arkwell while we gather artifacts? Need something that buys 48 hours but looks proactive.
sam_solutions: Draft: ```Hi Alex — thanks for the questionnaire. We're compiling the requested artifacts (SOC2 report excerpts, dataflow diagram, DPA redline responses, and key management details). We'll send the initial package within 48 hours and propose a 30-min walkthrough to go over any control-specific items. If there's anything immediate you'd like prioritized, please call that out. Best, Maria (on behalf of Redwood)```
joel_sec: Add one line about live attestations: "We maintain an annual SOC2 Type II with coverage of the Redwood inference platform; specific control mappings for data processing are attached."
tim_legal: On the DPA: they removed our liability cap in one clause. We should counter with standard language and offer a mutual indemnity scope. I'll annotate the PDF and push comments back by lunchtime.
maria_csm: Timeline: Tim — DPA redlines by 12:00. Joel — artifacts and SOC2 excerpts uploaded to the shared folder by 16:00. Sam — dataflow diagram + answers to infra Qs by 16:00. I'll send the reply and schedule the walkthrough.
security-bot: [Automated] Upload completed: retention_policy_v1.2.pdf (1768126001)
joel_sec: Uploaded SOC2 executive summary and control mapping table to folder: https://redwood.internal/s3/arkwell/evidence_bundle/ (items: soc2_summary.pdf, control_map.xlsx, infra-diagram-v3.png)
sam_solutions: I'm tagging a couple of config snippets they might ask for: 
```
# sample nginx TLS proto config
ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
ssl_ciphers HIGH:!aNULL:!MD5;
```
maria_csm: Great. Sending initial response now and proposing Fri 10am PT for a quick call. I'll DM you all the calendar invite. :calendar:
tim_legal: Sent DPA comments to Arkwell legal (track changes). Asked them to scope subcontractor obligations and restore the liability cap. Waiting on their ack.
joel_sec: Follow-up: Arkwell asked whether we use any third-party analytics that process PII. We should provide our subprocessor list and note our approach (data minimization, contractual constraints). I attached subprocessors.csv to the folder.
maria_csm: Thanks team — this is shaping up cleanly. If Arkwell asks for anything beyond the SOC2 scope (e.g., penetration test reports), let's route that to info@security with a short justification. I'll close thread after the walkthrough. :white_check_mark:
